title: The Starving South
description: The blight took the autumn harvest, the ghost pirates have held the bay for two months, and now bandits have the harbor warehouses too - Larton's stores are down to what a few hundred people can stretch across maybe six weeks. The Trade Master doesn't have six weeks to wait on Rotherhine's bureaucracy, but he doesn't have another road either. Petition the Empire, and bring back everything you can carry regardless of what they promise.

objectives.description: Hear the numbers from the Trade Master - what's left, and how long it lasts
Travel to Rotherhine to petition the Empire
Petition the Imperial Magistrate for aid
Gather what grain the petition actually buys (0/5)
Get the grain back to Larton before the stores run out

notes: Threat: Larton's stores estimated at six weeks for a few hundred people (invented for texture, no bible basis). Ties to retake_harbor (the warehouses just lost to bandits) and ghost_pirate_investigation (the blockade that started the shortage) - read together as one regional crisis from four desks; see aberdeen_relief and supply_line_crisis for Aberdeen's side of it.
